channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Why are Houthi missiles breaking through Saudi Arabia’s air defences?
item.description: Repeated Houthi attacks on Saudi Arabia's King Khalid Airport reveal the limitations of even high-tech air defences.

item.title: Hormuz attacks intensify as efforts to end war on Iran stall
item.description: IRGC warns against ignoring waterway's 'security and rules' as CENTCOM says US disabled vessel trying to run blockade.

item.title: Saudi Arabia vows response over Houthi ‘war crime’ attack on Riyadh airport
item.description: A Houthi attack on Riyadh airport killed at least 12 people and injured more than 300.

item.title: Yemen fighting expands as Houthis attack Saudi airport: What to know
item.description: Saudi coalition blames Houthi group for the missile attack on the main international airport in Riyadh.

item.title: Woman injures three people in third Poland school knife attack in a week
item.description: Polish police had already deployed to schools after a female caretaker was killed and several others injured in two earlier attacks in two days.

item.title: Drone strike by Sudan paramilitary kills 41 near Ethiopian border, rights group says
item.description: Eight children are said to be among those killed by the strike, which hit a gathering of displaced people.

item.title: Three men found guilty of murdering Australian brothers and US friend in Mexico
item.description: Jake and Callum Robinson and their friend Carter Rhoad were on a surf trip when they were killed in an apparent botched robbery.

item.title: Riyadh airport attack another dangerous moment in already tense conflict
item.description: The Houthis have stepped up their attacks on Saudi Arabian soil, and while the physical damage can be quickly repaired, its reputation for stability is taking a battering.
